title: CaptureRuleRegistry
description: Live checks, lock state machine counts and timings of the guided capture camera (build brief .claude/plans/2026-10-22-capture-camera-brief.md §3-§6). One source for the iOS and Android apps and the frame generator; tools/codegen/gen-kernel.mjs emits it as Swift CaptureRules.swift and Kotlin CaptureRules.kt and checks the cross-references a schema cannot express (family modes, body parts, hints and lock reasons are declared). Coordinates and shares are normalised to the analysis frame (0-1, portrait, origin top-left). A number this schema types integer is an Int in Swift and Kotlin; every other number is a Double. Field names carry the comparison: min/max pass inclusively, Below/Above trigger strictly. Ids are stable: never rename or reuse one.

captureModes.description: How the item is photographed (brief §2): laid flat, on a hanger, or worn

lockReasons.description: Blocking checks in priority order (brief §4 locked(reason), §6): the highest-priority failing one is the lock reason

bodyParts.description: Body keypoints the worn-mode body check reads (brief §3, §4 Part), named as in the keypoint files of brief §11

hints.description: Hint key (also the hint label's test ID) to its definition, in the priority order of brief §6. UI copy lives in each app's string resources, keyed by these ids

families.description: Shape family id to its rules (brief §2, §3), in picker order. Shape families, not closet taxonomy ids

edgeBandShare.description: Width of the band along each frame edge, as a share of that dimension; a box or mask inside it touches the edge

intervalMs.description: The lock machine reads the latest detector result at most once per this interval (10 Hz)

staleFeedAfterMs.description: No detector result for this long (an interruption, a stalled detector) sends a locked or unlocked shutter back to warming up; the anyway timer keeps running (brief §4)

analysisFrame.description: Analysis frame size: iOS preview-sized video buffers, Android ImageAnalysis target (KEEP_ONLY_LATEST)

steady.description: Steadiness checks (lock): box motion between two evaluations and sharpness inside the box

maxCentreShift.description: Steady when the box centre moves at most this much in x and in y

maxAreaChangeShare.description: Steady when the box area changes by at most this share

minSharpness.description: Steady when the Laplacian variance on luma inside the box is at least this

sharpnessLongSidePx.description: Luma is scaled so its long side is this many pixels before the sharpness check

laplacianKernelPx.description: Side of the square Laplacian kernel (3 x 3)

light.description: Light hints (never lock, brief Q15): mean luma of the whole frame, 0-255

clippedMinLuma.description: A pixel with luma at or above this counts as clipped

tooBrightAboveClippedShare.description: Too bright also when the share of clipped pixels exceeds this

tilt.description: Tilt hint (flat mode, phones only, never locks): angle between gravity and the phone's back axis, with hysteresis

covered.description: Partly covered item (brief §4, C32; flat and hanger modes, never worn): another mask instance's box overlaps the item's box. The item is the largest mask instance (iOS: Vision foreground instance; Android: connected component of the segmenter mask); overlap is the intersection divided by the smaller box's area

aboveOverlapShare.description: Covered (lock) when another box's overlap with the item box exceeds this share of the smaller box

minOtherBoxAreaShare.description: Another box counts only when it covers at least this share of the frame

unlockAfterPassingEvaluations.description: Consecutive passing evaluations that unlock the shutter

relockAfterFailingEvaluations.description: Consecutive failing evaluations that lock it again and reset the ring

ringFillMs.description: Passing time from the unlock until the ring is full and auto-capture fires

ringMinEvaluations.description: The ring is full only after at least this many passing evaluations as well

cooldownExitEvaluations.description: Consecutive no-item evaluations, or consecutive evaluations of a new item, that end the cooldown

newItemBelowIou.description: A box is a new item when its IoU with the captured box is below this

anywayDelayMs.description: Foreground time since cameraReady before "Take photo anyway" shows (at once with a screen reader)

guideHintMs.description: The family instruction shows this long after cameraReady unless the shutter unlocks earlier

hintHoldEvaluations.description: A new hint replaces the shown one only after holding for this many consecutive evaluations

hintMinVisibleMs.description: ...and only when the shown hint has been visible at least this long

speechRepeatWindowMs.description: The same text is not spoken again within this window

worn.description: Worn mode (brief §3, Q-A b): the edge rule is off, this size minimum applies to every family, and the body check locks

minAreaShare.description: Too small below this box area share, every family

keypointMinCoordinate.description: A keypoint is present only when x and y are at least this (the frame minus the edge band)

mask.description: The item mask, read by both apps (brief §3): iOS from the Vision foreground instance mask, Android from the LiteRT segmenter mask split into connected components. Each app measures it the same way

intervalMs.description: Mask cadence: at most one new mask per this interval, newest frame only, one request in flight

hotIntervalMs.description: Mask cadence while the phone is hot: Android uses it when it reports THERMAL_STATUS_MODERATE or worse. iOS does not read it

minInstanceAreaShare.description: Item found when a mask instance covers at least this share of the frame

cutOffAboveEdgeContactShare.description: Cut off when mask pixels inside an edge band span more than this share of that edge's length

hangerTopCutOffAboveEdgeContactShare.description: The same rule for the top edge in hanger mode

outline.description: The live outline traced from each new mask (brief 'Live outline'). These equal the params of the parity fixture tools/capture-frames/parity/outline-parity.json, whose maskIntervalMs is mask.intervalMs; both apps' parity tests assert it

cropGrowDivisor.description: The crop around the item grows by the item box's long side divided by this (integer division)

cropGrowMinPx.description: ...and by at least this many pixels

longSidePx.description: The crop is area-averaged down to this long side, in pixels

foregroundAtLeast.description: An area-averaged cell at or above this is foreground; also the contour's iso value

keepAtLeastIou.description: The drawn item is kept while its new outline overlaps the drawn one by at least this IoU

switchAtAreaRatio.description: ...unless the largest candidate has at least this many times its area

snapBelowIou.description: A new outline below this IoU with the drawn one jumps there without animation

snapKeepsShapeAtLeastIou.description: ...and its shape replaces the drawn shape only below this IoU of the two shapes centred on their centroids; otherwise the shape still blends

emaAlpha.description: Weight of the new outline in the moving averages of position and shape

clearAfterMissedUpdates.description: The outline clears after this many mask updates in a row without an item

iouGridCells.description: Outline IoU rasterises both polygons on this many cells per side over their joint box

ios.description: iOS-only values (Vision body pose, Core Motion)

poseIntervalMs.description: Body pose cadence in worn mode, same frame and handler as the mask request

maxUserAccelerationG.description: Steady when user acceleration is at most this (g)

maxRotationRateRadPerS.description: ...and the rotation rate at most this (rad/s)

minKeypointConfidence.description: A body joint is present when its Vision confidence is at least this

android.description: Android-only values (ML Kit Pose base model, linear acceleration)

maxLinearAccelerationMps2.description: Steady when linear acceleration (accelerometer minus low-pass gravity) is at most this (m/s²)

gravityLowPassAlpha.description: Smoothing factor of the gravity low-pass filter

minKeypointInFrameLikelihood.description: A pose landmark is present when its in-frame likelihood is at least this

kind.description: blocking: shown while the shutter is locked; advisory: never locks, shown only when no blocking check fails; status: guide and state messages

lockReason.description: The lock reason this hint reports (blocking hints only; warming-up has none)

minAreaShare.description: Too small when box area / frame area is below this (flat and hanger modes)

wornRequiredParts.description: Body parts that must all be present in worn mode, from bodyParts; empty when the family has no body check

wornHint.description: The hint shown when a required part is missing; present exactly when wornRequiredParts is not empty
